The '''Mercybringer''' was a type of ion [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] missile produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Mercybringer was capable of downing most enemy shields and short onboard power systems in one hit, despite the minimal hull damage, and the missile possessed a moderate lock-on period and a long range.<ref name="Starfighter" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
